curated_top_10_lists.title: Top 10 Masterpieces of World Literature
curated_top_10_lists.consensus_method: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) across 4 International Institutional Syllabi
evaluating_sources: Le Monde's 100 Books of the Century (International Syndicate)

ranked_items.title: War and Peace
ranked_items.author: Leo Tolstoy
ranked_items.justification: Universally acclaimed panoramic synthesis of human psychology, philosophical determinism, and Napoleonic historical warfare.

ranked_items.title: Gitanjali (Song Offerings)
ranked_items.author: Rabindranath Tagore
ranked_items.justification: First non-Western Nobel-winning poetic masterpiece bridging profound Indian humanist spiritualism with universal lyrical elegance.

ranked_items.title: Hamlet, Prince of Denmark
ranked_items.author: William Shakespeare
ranked_items.justification: The definitive dramatic exploration of moral hesitation, human existential doubt, and political succession.

ranked_items.title: The Odyssey
ranked_items.author: Homer
ranked_items.justification: The foundational epic of Western narrative storytelling, charting Odysseus's ten-year metaphysical journey home.

ranked_items.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
ranked_items.author: Gabriel García Márquez
ranked_items.justification: Pinnacle of magical realism, capturing the generational cycles of solitude, Latin American post-colonial trauma, and memory.

ranked_items.title: The Divine Comedy (Inferno, Purgatorio, Paradiso)
ranked_items.author: Dante Alighieri
ranked_items.justification: The monumental medieval poetic vision of spiritual redemption and allegorical cosmic order.

ranked_items.title: Don Quixote
ranked_items.author: Miguel de Cervantes
ranked_items.justification: Regarded as the first modern psychological novel, brilliantly subverting chivalric romance through idealism and reality.

ranked_items.title: Crime and Punishment
ranked_items.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
ranked_items.justification: Unrivaled psychological analysis of guilt, utilitarian hubris (Raskolnikov), and moral resurrection.

ranked_items.title: Godan (The Gift of a Cow)
ranked_items.author: Munshi Premchand
ranked_items.justification: The crowning masterpiece of modern Hindi-Urdu literature, offering an unflinching realistic portrait of Indian peasant exploitation and resilience.

ranked_items.title: Faust (Part I & II)
ranked_items.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
ranked_items.justification: The supreme philosophical drama of the modern striving spirit, the wager with Mephistopheles, and the search for enlightenment.

curated_top_10_lists.title: Top 10 Discoveries in the History of Physics
curated_top_10_lists.consensus_method: American Physical Society (APS) & Royal Swedish Academy Landmark Consensus
evaluating_sources: Nobel Committee for Physics Centennial Compendium

ranked_items.title: Newtonian Classical Mechanics & Universal Gravitation (1687)
ranked_items.impact: Unified celestial orbital mechanics with terrestrial dynamics using calculus.

ranked_items.title: Maxwell's Equations & Electromagnetic Field Unification (1865)
ranked_items.impact: Proved light is an electromagnetic wave and unified electricity and magnetism.

ranked_items.title: General Relativity & Curved Spacetime (1915)
ranked_items.impact: Replaced Newtonian gravitational force with the geometric curvature of 4D spacetime.

ranked_items.title: Quantum Mechanics & Wave-Particle Duality (1925-1927)
ranked_items.discoverer: Max Planck, Erwin Schrödinger, Werner Heisenberg, Louis de Broglie
ranked_items.impact: Proved the atomic world is governed by quantized energy packets and probabilistic wavefunctions.

ranked_items.title: Laws of Thermodynamics & Statistical Entropy
ranked_items.discoverer: Sadi Carnot, Rudolf Clausius, Ludwig Boltzmann
ranked_items.impact: Established conservation of energy (1st law) and the irreversible arrow of time (2nd law).

ranked_items.title: Special Relativity & Mass-Energy Equivalence E = mc^2 (1905)
ranked_items.impact: Overthrew absolute time, proving mass and energy are interchangeable manifestations.

ranked_items.title: Discovery of the Atomic Nucleus & Rutherford Scattering (1911)
ranked_items.impact: Discovered that the vast majority of atomic mass is concentrated in a tiny dense positive nucleus.

ranked_items.title: Quantum Electrodynamics (QED) Renormalization (1948)
ranked_items.discoverer: Richard Feynman, Julian Schwinger, Shinichiro Tomonaga
ranked_items.impact: The most precise physical theory ever constructed, matching experimental magnetic moments to 12 decimal places.

ranked_items.title: The Raman Effect (Inelastic Molecular Light Scattering, 1928)
ranked_items.impact: Provided experimental proof of quantum photon-molecule energy exchange, founding modern spectroscopy.

ranked_items.title: Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) & Big Bang Origin (1964)
ranked_items.impact: Confirmed the cosmological Big Bang thermal relic radiation at 2.725 Kelvin.

how_to_guides.title: How to Scientifically Diagnose Plant Diseases in the Field
how_to_guides.authoritative_source: ICAR-IARI Division of Plant Pathology & Agrios' Plant Pathology

steps.detail: Verify normal cultivar leaf morphology, growth habit, and coloration to rule out natural genetic variegation.
Uniform field-wide damage indicates abiotic stress (drought, salinity, frost, spray burn). Random patchy clustering indicates biotic living pathogens.
Bacterial infections exhibit water-soaked margins with bacterial ooze. Fungal spots show concentric rings (target boards) and fungal sporulation signs.
Perform the 30-second clear water bacterial streaming test in a glass jar or examine underside mycelial felt.

steps.action: Implement FRAC-Approved Mode of Action Rotation
steps.detail: Never spray identical chemical classes consecutively; alternate systemic protectants with contact multi-site barriers.

how_to_guides.title: How to Calculate Plane Wall Heat Conduction and Thermal Insulation
how_to_guides.authoritative_source: Incropera & DeWitt Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer

steps.detail: Determine material conductivity k in W/(m*K). (e.g. Glass wool k = 0.04, Concrete k = 1.4).
Measure surface area A in square meters (m^2) and insulation layer thickness L in meters.
Calculate interior temperature minus exterior temperature in Kelvin or Celsius.
Compute total heat loss rate: q = (k * A * Delta_T) / L (in Watts). Thermal resistance is R = L / (k * A).

what_is_primers.title: What is the Basic Structure Doctrine?
what_is_primers.authoritative_source: Supreme Court of India (Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala, 1973)
what_is_primers.axiomatic_summary: The Basic Structure Doctrine is a landmark constitutional principle holding that while Parliament possesses broad constituent amending powers under Article 368, it cannot alter, damage, or emasculate the core foundational identity of the Constitution—including democracy, judicial review, the rule of law, federalism, and fundamental rights.

what_is_primers.title: What is Quantum Entanglement?
what_is_primers.authoritative_source: Feynman Lectures on Physics & EPR-Bell Formalism
what_is_primers.axiomatic_summary: Quantum entanglement is a physical phenomenon where two or more particles become intertwined such that the physical quantum state of each particle cannot be described independently of the other, regardless of the physical distance separating them, demonstrating non-local quantum correlations verified by violations of Bell's inequalities.
